moods.mood_description: A final all-out effort or ultimate sacrifice at the last moment
Moving forward by overcoming all obstacles, setbacks, or challenges
The immediate realization that success is imminent or victory is assured
Expressions of jubilation, applause, or collective joy
Feeling the worth of hard work, perseverance, and sacrifice
Deep satisfaction and pride in achieving a goal

Confidence after victory and new inspiration for the future
Establishing a lasting impression or precedent that will be remembered
